digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions workflows for main branch health reporting
propositions: Cancelled scheduled runs on main render as red X on GitHub despite main being healthy, because concurrency group collapses pushes and cancels in-progress runs.

Four comparable Gerrit-primary mirrors (golang/go, openstack/nova, LibreOffice/core, aosp-mirror) surface zero per-commit CI on GitHub; Zuul's supercedent manager and Chromium's 7-10 hour post-submit batches prove batching is standard practice.
GitHub Actions cannot natively hide cancelled runs, and cancel-in-progress: false with queue: single still produces red X on a different run.

Switching test.yml, optionality.yml, verify-identity.yml, prompt-eval.yml, codeql.yml, and terraform-drift.yml from push-triggered to schedule-only (every 6 hours for cheap checks, weekly/daily for others) removes cancellations by construction.

The main-health-report job must resolve last-known-green SHA from Actions API and emit a copy-pasteable git bisect recipe to $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY so first responders can close a multi-commit regression window in 3-5 builds.
Gerrit's per-patchset Verified gate is unaffected; the change only alters when the safety net runs, not what gates a merge.
